tickets.summary: K-3401 non-drive-end bearing vibration rose from 2.1 to 4.6 mm/s in six weeks, with growing 1x and sidebands; it remains below alarm but has not plateaued.
tickets.recommended_action: Rotating equipment specialist inspect today; diagnose NDE vibration, repair as found, and verify acceptable vibration. Check failure mode and personnel exposure. impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the single main gas export compressor train has no spare or workaround and would send the platform to recycle, cutting production within an hour.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first weekly test start, then started after eight seconds and achieved rated pressure; recurrent starting-system issues indicate degraded firewater readiness.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire protection engineer to inspect batteries/start air, correct findings, disposition service, and verify repeated starts and rated pressure. Check impairment/deviation record. Repeat demand-start function test. Test FW-8101 pressure and flow. Test cranking voltage and start air.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A required start attempt failed during a function test. The successful second attempt and normal run preserve chronology but do not reverse the confirmed initial loss of start function.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure to start degrades safety-critical firewater protection. FW-8101 is the nominated partner, but its later test showed 9.2 barg against 11 barg with flow unmeasured, so capable redundancy cannot be credited.

tickets.summary: P-3305 has repeatedly lost inhibitor delivery, with three low-pressure trips this month and intermittent injection for about ten days; diaphragm failure remains suspected.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect pump and diaphragm; repair per findings under corrosion engineer disposition; verify required injection rate. Assess downstream corrosion exposure. Check approved deviation record. Confirm sustained inhibitor injection. Inspect diaphragm and trip cause.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The required inhibitor-delivery function has already been interrupted three times this month and remained intermittent for around ten days.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of the sole corrosion-inhibitor pump can starve downstream carbon steel, initiating corrosion within weeks and creating a severe delayed integrity consequence without stopping production immediately.

tickets.summary: FW-8101 stabilized at 9.2 barg versus 11 barg design with flow unmeasured; delivery capability is uncertain, while FW-8102 previously failed its first test-start attempt.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire-protection engineer to assess disposition; inspect pump and test-line valves, correct findings, then verify pressure and flow to criteria. Function-test FW-8102 capability. Inspect pump and test-line valves. Test pressure and flow to criteria.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Below-design running pressure is meaningful degradation, but unmeasured flow and an unstated acceptance criterion prevent confirmation of required-function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this safety-critical firewater pump would materially degrade major-accident protection. The partner previously failed its first test-start attempt, although it subsequently started and achieved rated pressure, so current redundancy cannot be credited or assumed lost.

tickets.summary: Second-stage discharge-line cladding is loose and flapping; secure-retention function is lost and a dropped-object hazard exists, although personnel exposure is unknown.
tickets.recommended_action: Barricade the drop zone; have mechanical engineering inspect, repair or secure the cladding, and verify stability. Check drop-zone personnel exposure.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The cladding is already loose and flapping, confirming loss of its secure-retention function, although it has not yet fallen.

impact_of_failure.rationale: If the unsecured cladding falls, it presents a credible dropped-object hazard. The finding excludes a process concern, but personnel exposure and potential injury severity are unknown.
